description: Render an interactive line chart of unique visitors and page views over time for a host you own, and return the period totals as text. Returns a rendered chart in MCP-Apps-capable hosts (a text summary elsewhere) plus the totals. Use when asked to chart, graph, draw, or visualize growth or traffic for a subdomain. The host must be a verified origin of the project, or the request is rejected.

host.description: The host to chart, e.g. 'wes.example.com'. Must be a verified origin of the selected app.

project.description: The app to read (its project id, from list_projects). Required with a workspace key unless set via use_project.

name: draw_user_growth
title: Draw user growth over time
